title: Vintage Grimjack Casefiles Comic Lot Issues 2 & 3, First Comics
descriptionText: The product is a vintage comic lot featuring issues 2 and 3 of the Grimjack Casefiles series by writer Bill Ostrander. Published by First Comics in the US, these comics showcase the character Grimjack in a unique and gritty narrative. With a strong emphasis on storytelling and character development, this collectible comic set is a must-have for fans of the genre and collectors of vintage comics.
